claims.text: Acute nonulcerative blepharitis with swelling >24 h: fluorometholone ophthalmic ointment
claims.quote: Treatment of acute nonulcerative blepharitis begins with avoiding the offending action (eg, rubbing) or substance (eg, new eye drops). Warm compresses over the closed eyelid may relieve symptoms and speed resolution. If swelling persists > 24 hours, topical glucocorticoids (eg, fluorometholone ophthalmic ointment) can be used.
